title: mirabilis laevis subsp. glutinosa
intro: Mirabilis laevis subsp. glutinosa, commonly known as California desert four o'clock, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to treat skin conditions and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Mirabilis laevis subsp. glutinosa include its analgesic, antipyretic, and antiseptic actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids. Additionally, this plant is rich in antioxidants, which contribute to its overall health-promoting effects.
